pictures.name: QTR1-Garden
pictures.prompt: A paradise garden at morning: endless fruit trees, flowering bushes, clear streams winding through soft grass, gold light filtering through high leaves, birds in the branches. Abundant, generous, open in every direction. No people or human figures of any kind, no hands, no silhouettes, no faces. No angels, spirits or beings of any kind in any form, not even as figures of light, glowing shapes or wings. Contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike, rich textiles and textures, deep blue shadows, warm gold lamplight, slow and still. One tall 9:16 vertical picture, main subject in the middle. No text, no letters, no logos.
